name: Tabby
author: Pablo Saura
description: Tabby as a first-class Omarchy terminal: live theme and font sync, default-terminal support with smart working directory, universal clipboard, dropdown, profiles in the bar, and secure launching.

barWidget.description: Tabby status, profiles and integration settings. Left click for the panel, middle click for a new tab, right click to toggle the dropdown.

schema.label: Show tab count
